## Diagnosis

I pulled the GSC exports and crawled the live site. The picture is a classic **product pivot gone un-cleaned-up**:

**The business pivoted.** The site used to be "InboxZap" (email cleanup / inbox-zero tool). It's now "Lumina" (AI meeting assistant) — totally different product, ICP, and keywords. But the SEO surface never caught up:

1. **Branded traffic is leaking to the wrong product.** `inboxzap` / `inboxzap app` / `inboxzap review` are the *top queries* by clicks (14+3+1), ranking ~#4-9, landing searchers on a meeting-assistant homepage with zero acknowledgment of the rename. That's pure bounce — and confused-user signals erode the ranking over time.
2. **The blog is broken and orphaned.** `/blog` fetches posts from `/api/posts` client-side — which 404s. Googlebot (and users) see "Loading posts…" and nothing else. The 12 individual posts (`/blog/post-1`…`post-12`) still exist and still get real impressions (3900, 1650, 1380…) but there is **no link anywhere on the site to any of them**, and they're **missing entirely from `sitemap.ts`** (there's literally a `// TODO: include blog posts once content API is stable`). They're invisible to crawlers except via stale index history.
3. **All 12 posts target the old product.** Every single one is about Gmail/inbox cleanup — "Bulk Delete Emails," "Gmail Storage Full," etc. None are relevant to meeting transcription/summaries. Even if traffic reached them, it wouldn't convert to Lumina signups. Meanwhile there is **zero content** targeting the keywords that would actually convert (meeting notes, transcription, action items, Zoom/Meet/Teams recap, async meetings).
4. **Stale/broken metadata in source.** `app/layout.tsx` still has the old InboxZap title/description/OG image baked into root metadata — a regression waiting to ship.
5. **Smaller bugs:** nav links to `/faq`, which 404s (the redirect in `next.config.js` points to `/#faq`, but no FAQ section/anchor exists anywhere); homepage/features images have no `alt` text; `/features` has two `<h1>`s.

## Plan

**Fix now (clear bugs, no judgment call):**
- Make `/blog` render posts server-side with real `<a href>` links instead of a broken client fetch
- Add real `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` pages with proper per-post metadata
- Add blog posts to `sitemap.ts`
- Fix `layout.tsx` metadata back to Lumina branding
- Add a real FAQ section with an `id="faq"` anchor + FAQPage schema (captures long-tail queries, fixes the dead link)
- Add `alt` text to images, fix duplicate `<h1>` on `/features`

**Needs your call:**
- **Old InboxZap posts** — redirect them (301) to relevant Lumina content/homepage to recover some link equity and stop confusing visitors, or leave them live as-is? I'd lean toward redirecting since they can't convert and hurt topical coherence.
- **Brand bridge** — add a short "Lumina was formerly InboxZap" note (footer or small page) to capture that branded query intent instead of losing it to confusion?
- **New content** — want me to draft 2-3 new blog posts targeting actual Lumina keywords (meeting notes, transcription accuracy, action-item tracking) as a starting cluster?

Want me to go ahead with all of the above, or adjust scope first?
